contracts.blurb: The cooperative keeps its ajo savings with you and pays a small fee for every payout.
Traders settle grain payments through your bank at harvest time.
Teachers' salaries are paid into PadiTrust accounts every month.
Clinics collect patient payments on your POS terminals.
Kenyan partners route family transfers to Nigeria through you.
Nigerians in the UK send money home through a bank they know.

belt.name: Note Counting Machine
belt.blurb: Counts and bundles deposits at once, so each teller serves twice as fast.

auto.name: ATM Gallery
auto.blurb: Serves withdrawals without a teller; the vault refills it.

pack.name: Mobile App Data Centre
pack.blurb: Handles transfers, bills and small loans on phones; cash moves by vault conveyor.

milestones.title: Second Branch
milestones.blurb: Ibadan opens. Same green logo, same welcome at the door.

milestones.title: Five Branches
milestones.blurb: Market women across Lagos and Oyo know PadiTrust by name.

milestones.title: Salary Accounts
milestones.blurb: Schools and clinics pay their staff into PadiTrust accounts.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Branches in the North, East and South-South, each with its own manager.

milestones.title: Clean Books
milestones.blurb: Fifty branches and bad loans still under 5%.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Nairobi and Accra branches open with local managers.

milestones.title: Teller Academy
milestones.blurb: PadiTrust trains its own tellers and credit officers.

milestones.title: The People's Bank
milestones.blurb: The first umbrella and POS sit in the museum corner of the head office.

staff: Cash bag for the vault, coming!
Float is full, we are ready.
Vault balanced to the last kobo.
Credit check done, the shop is real.
Till topped up from the vault.
Guard escort to the vault, clear.
customer: I want to open a savings account.
How much is the transfer fee?
Can I see my repay chance before I sign?
My shop needs a small loan for stock.
Thank you for the polite reminder.
The queue is moving fast today.
I pay my light bill here every month.
manager: T-bills are ready if the queue grows.
Credit Officer checked every loan this week.
The examiner said our books are clean.
night: One umbrella, one POS. Look at us now.
Tomorrow I check the till before I open.
Every customer paid today. That is the job.

events.name: Salary Day Rush
events.text: Month end! Workers flood in to withdraw. Keep the till full.

events.name: Network Is Down
events.text: POS and transfers hang for a while. Fewer customers today.

events.name: Ajo Payout Day
events.text: The market cooperative pays out. More customers at the counter.

events.name: Bullion Van in Traffic
events.text: The van is stuck on the bridge. Cash bags arrive slowly today.

events.name: Clean Inspection
events.text: The examiner finds every kobo in place. A fee is waived for you.

events.name: Rate Cut News
events.text: The central bank trims its rate. More traders come in today.

events.name: Generator Wahala
events.text: No light in the banking hall. Diesel costs extra today.

events.name: Teller Training Day
events.text: Tellers practised on the new note counter. Service is quicker today.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Cash bags carried from the door to the vault under a guard's eye

mech.name: Cash trolley
mech.how: Steel trolley with a locked box rolls from the counter to the vault

mech.name: Pneumatic tube
mech.how: Capsules whoosh cash from the counters to the vault room

mech.name: Bullion van
mech.how: Armoured green van backs into the bay, boxes move into the strong room

mech.name: Vault conveyor
mech.how: Sealed belt carries cash boxes between the vault and the ATM gallery

mech.name: Cash centre
mech.how: Automated cash centre sorts, counts and dispatches for every branch

storyNote: Story follows plan2/bank.json. The 'Fake Alert Attempt' event is left out: no fraud of any kind appears in the game. No special cheap farm loan; loans to the owner's own businesses use outside terms.
